question: Can ten internally supported Dholavira accession records be bridged to corpus families using identifiers or individual photographs?
outcome: Ten primary photograph panels and seven measurement records checked against 62 candidate families and 274 retained edges. Four exact measurement triples and one further exact h/v candidate identified. Zero supported bridges; all ten remain unresolved because no corpus photograph or shared complete accession was recovered.
challenge: No candidate corpus photos in held index; public ICIT returns 401, old ASI report URL 404, institutional cover only 2 pages. Source sign-count and identifier differences retained.
remedy: Freeze complete block and strict admission rules, inspect accession-labelled photographs, preserve all candidate edges, record exploratory measurement concordance and precise missing accession/photo evidence.
retry_when: Obtain candidate corpus photographs or a complete accession concordance; inspect damage and outline against the saved primary panels.
